major_cooldowns.name: Dream Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast rank 1 on cooldown for steady damage, swap to rank 3 to answer a burst window, and as Flameshaper keep one charge always on cooldown while saving the second for danger.

major_cooldowns.name: Fire Breath
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it at rank 3 for its big AoE damage and party heal, and time it with a known raid damage window.

major_cooldowns.name: Emerald Blossom
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Cast it whenever you have an Essence Burst, unless you are already at two stacks of Twin Echoes, in which case press Echo instead.

major_cooldowns.name: Stasis (Store)
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Store a Temporal Anomaly and at least one Dream Breath ahead of time, then release the set together over a planned damage window; store three Temporal Anomaly casts pre-pull if there is an early key damage event.

major_cooldowns.name: Tip the Scales
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: As Chronowarden, combine it with your Stasis release so the Temporal Burst haste it grants covers the burst; otherwise use it to instantly empower a Dream Breath or Fire Breath when you need the value immediately.

major_cooldowns.name: Rewind
major_cooldowns.usage_rule: Line it up with the fight's most dangerous damage moment and press it right as the damage lands, since it heals from the prior five seconds taken.

rule.description: Emerald Blossom filler during Essence Burst
rule.action: Press Emerald Blossom while Essence Burst is up, but switch to Echo once Twin Echoes is at two stacks.

rule.description: Don't overcap Twin Echoes with Emerald Blossom
rule.action: Spend Echo to bring Twin Echoes down before pressing another Emerald Blossom.
Consume your Echo buffs with Merithra's Blessing as soon as it procs instead of letting it expire.

rule.description: Hold Tip the Scales for Stasis (Store) release
rule.action: Save Tip the Scales for your Stasis (Store) release so its Haste burst covers the payoff.

rule.description: Buff the raid, then pre-pull Temporal Anomaly
rule.action: Cast Blessing of the Bronze first, then pre-cast Temporal Anomaly a few seconds before pulling so you start the fight with Echo buffs out.
